title: Entry Requirements for the Larkspur Valuables Floater Tiers
content:
Every tier of the Larkspur Valuables Floater is written only for a customer who meets that tier's entry requirements: a live Larkspur residence policy, a minimum total scheduled value, and a ceiling on theft claims over the past five years.

## Entry requirements by tier

| Tier | Live Larkspur residence policy required | Minimum schedule total (USD) | Most theft claims in 5 years |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | yes | 0 | 1 |
| Valuables Floater Select | yes | 10000 | 1 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | yes | 25000 | 1 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | yes | 50000 | 1 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | yes | 100000 | 0 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | yes | 250000 | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- **Residence policy.** No tier is written without a live Larkspur residence policy; the requirement is the same on all six tiers.
- **Minimum schedule total.** The Valuables Floater Classic has no minimum. Each higher tier needs a schedule total of at least the figure in its row: a hypothetical schedule of exactly 25000 USD meets the Preferred minimum, and one of 24900 USD does not.
- **Theft claims in 5 years.** The Classic, Select, Preferred and Prestige tiers accept a customer with at most one theft claim in five years; the Collector and Private Client tiers accept none.

Hypothetical cases, judged on the entry requirements alone:

- A customer with a live Larkspur residence policy, a schedule total of 45000 USD and no theft claim in five years meets the entry requirements of the Classic, Select and Preferred tiers, and is below the minimum schedule total of the Prestige, Collector and Private Client tiers.
- A customer with a live Larkspur residence policy, a schedule total of 400000 USD and one theft claim in five years meets the entry requirements of the Prestige tier, and has too many theft claims for the Collector and Private Client tiers.
